summary: A misnamed finding file is named twice by gate check: SpecCoverageCheck now emits malformed-evidence for every corpus layout violation, and review_gate::malformed_findings (review_gate.rs:295-313) already emits one for each Finding corpus violation when require_review.block_on_findings is on, which is the default and what canon init scaffolds. Repro on b71529db: canon init, finding add, rename add-login_1_1_x.json to _1_2_: gate check --json lists two malformed-evidence violations with the same subject kind=finding/add-login_1_2_x.json. The exit code is unchanged and the count is doubled. Fix: skip RecordKind::Finding in SpecCoverageCheck when block_on_findings is on, or skip layout violations in malformed_findings
